question: Can a single selective policy choose the source-supported update operation for each changed tool and satisfy the full original gate, rather than optimizing only one failure class?
previous_turn_classification: Progress: reviewed_coverage reached original development and observed dual-rate gains, but failed whole-changed TF. Its version remains closed.
bounded_input_check: Inspected only current handoff/result, changed133/283 metadata, the semantic-claim-repair component and earlier independent-review conclusions. Changed133 descriptions are short and lack the same large repeated parameter block; broader deletion has no demonstrated safe magnitude there. No377 search or full history/review reload.

five_classes.knowledge: Fact: prior LLM claim repair changed2/8 annotations with source/probe entailment review and reduced misleading claims; reviewed deletion preserves all schemas/unique information. Neither individually established full Goal.
five_classes.execution: Fact: reviewed-coverage dev had3project max_rounds and2math length truncations. Observation: its complete project used67calls versus56SP; fewer calls is not the demonstrated sufficient mechanism.
five_classes.artifact: Fact: prior repair improved local validation but0/2math core; reviewed deletion produced1/2project core but0/2math core. Complete correct generation remains the highest impact bottleneck.
five_classes.environment_data: Original133/283/235 inputs complete and catalogs frozen; native broken functions are preserved, not repaired by changing runtime. Source certificates already identify their exact limited behavior.
five_classes.evaluation: Same-knowledge133 execution varied; officialTF and actual products diverged. No causal attribution of133drop to deletion. Small exposed dev samples cannot establish repeatability; strict full gates and both fresh blocks remain mandatory.

ranked_bottlenecks.bottleneck: Complete correct artifacts after locally correct tool use
ranked_bottlenecks.basis: Repeated across prior studies;9/10latest products not fully passing. Tool knowledge can remove unsupported guarantees and represent available operations more faithfully, but residual generation may dominate.

ranked_bottlenecks.bottleneck: Competing needs of truth repair and concise knowledge within fixed execution budget
ranked_bottlenecks.basis: Claim repair locally improved133TF/validation and deletion locally improved283completion/core in separate samples. Both are limited observations, not known stable effects. A single-operation policy leaves the other evidence class untouched.

selected_mechanism.name: evidence_dispatch v1
selected_mechanism.decision_changed: For each changed root, select exact claim repair when a reviewed source/native contradiction certificate exists, exact redundant-line deletion when a reviewed surviving-source coverage certificate exists, or originalSP when neither applies. Merge disjoint affected records; reject overlap/stale contracts/tampered policies.
selected_mechanism.inputs: Old/target tool catalogs and two frozen task-free certificate types. No task ID, benchmark question, answer, artifact, score or trajectory is supplied to the compiler or incorporated into its content.
selected_mechanism.fields: Claim repair changes existing description/parameter-description strings only. Coverage deletes certified description lines only. Required/type/enum/range/default, tool names/order/count, routing, output schemas, usage rules and all unrelated knowledge are protected.
selected_mechanism.localization: Actual metadata diff supplies changed roots. Native math contract fingerprints and exact proposal digests guard repair; full thinking-tool contract hashes and exact coverage policy digests guard deletion. A mixed-catalog deterministic test demonstrates both can apply without task routing.
selected_mechanism.LLM_role: Reuse the earlier two LLM claim decisions (4retained/10replaced across stages), which selected content and retain/replace decisions, not just wording. No new LLM generation or learned operator router is claimed; new operator selection/composition is deterministic and researcher-authored.
selected_mechanism.difference_from_closed_versions: Previously one policy repaired contradictory math claims while leaving other server knowledgeSP, and another deleted thinking-document redundancy while leaving mathSP. This new whole policy applies both evidence types. Individual component bytes deliberately remain unchanged; this is a new composite policy, not a new claim about either old version or within-task synergy.
selected_mechanism.why_potential_dual_gain: Source-truth repair may reduce invalid assumptions and unnecessary probing while coverage deletion may reduce available-document load without losing contract information. Their conditional combination targets both original changed families while235 remains exactSP. The full trial, not historical best-case aggregation, decides success.
selected_mechanism.limits: Known reviewed contracts, manual evidence certification, exposed task families and selected components informed by development evidence. No universal router/generalization claim. On the current original catalog families the components apply disjointly, so the trial estimates whole-policy performance, not interaction or pure causal contribution of each operator.

candidate_comparison.support: Complementary source-certified operators with distinct local gains; untested whole policy can be executed with complete original inputs and existing fair protocol.
candidate_comparison.counterevidence: Both components individually failed strict development; artifact construction may still dominate and local gains may be ordinary execution variation.

candidate_comparison.reason: Changed133 metadata lacks a demonstrated redundant block comparable to thinking tools. More deletion is not presently supported; do not manufacture a larger edit to rerun the closed policy.

Source scheduling equivalence exists, but prior original TF declined markedly and neither283completion/core improved. It also leaves the other changed family untreated. Adding another instruction is not currently the strongest complementary evidence.

literature_source_pins.actual_mechanism: Prepared simplified tool instructions consumed by staged tool/API/argument selection.
literature_source_pins.borrowed: Information-preserving local documentation compaction only; no staged actor executor or full replication.

literature_source_pins.actual_mechanism: Model decides semantic relationships and evolution of stored entries using retrieved related context.
literature_source_pins.borrowed: Prior component's explicit retain/replace judgment, with native source/probe input instead of online task memories. No embedding retrieval, task-memory evolution or new graph closure.

literature_source_pins.actual_mechanism: Feedback-based rule revision can use failure critique without success history.
literature_source_pins.borrowed: Task-free counterevidence can justify revision without a successful benchmark episode. No benchmark experience reflection or actor retry. The current dispatcher is our engineering composition, not an author algorithm.

review_integration: Reuse completed independent review: local sources/citations are not enough without entailment, positive episodes are not a universal prerequisite, LLM decisions must be described accurately, and proposed scope must correspond to actual changes. The two component semantic reviews remain required and pinned; no new agent/review loop.

authority.course: Brief SHA2566a74fda17b7a8b9280151e55ec46b46a70d1d717e4be24c5f9c38d134611af0d: selective changed knowledge, fixed comparison conditions, NU/FR/SP, original provenance and metrics/repro. Integrated report retained; user ended presentation and cancelled slides/scripts.
authority.user: Complete original frozen changed subset, strict completion+actual-quality gain, TF and retention nondecrease, two separately passing fresh batches, task-free updater, main-only same-branch edits/execution, no push or total cap.
authority.fairness: Same model/provider/decode/per-call/round/runtime/judge, ten original dev cells and two conditional30-cell batches. No old results substituted for fresh control or validation. Same backup billing credential within the new study, no .env rewrite.
authority.implementation: One operator for every affected tool is not a user requirement. Combining source-certified operators is admissible if the new whole policy is explicit and fairly tested. Old failed components/results are retained; no waived gate or posthoc task exclusion. Existing500character gate remains satisfied by the unchanged deletion component, not imposed on the semantic-repair component.

falsification: If any full dev gate fails, close this whole policy without resampling. If it passes, execute both fresh30-cell blocks with exact candidate bytes and require each to pass. Any original byte-identical component may fail to reproduce its local gain; that weakens the complementarity hypothesis. No arm/component selection after results.
costs: Zero new updater calls; inherited accepted claim generation USD0.0032346 disclosed separately, not double-charged. Human source authoring/review disclosed.
